verdict.rationale: LangSmith supports rule-based automation via threshold alerts on metrics (run count, cost, errors, feedback score, latency) that route to Slack/PagerDuty/webhooks, and online evaluators that run automatically on production traces—both event-triggered actions. However, this is scoped to observability/quality workflows rather than general-purpose 'if event then action' automation, and no community evidence validates real-world reliability of these automation rules.
